aanvaardings.bewering: Spoel langer by sterk goed soos bleikmiddel.
aanvaardings.rede: Sources differ on whether household bleach is the example of a 'strong' substance that needs rinsing longer than 15 to 20 minutes. Strong alkalis such as drain cleaner clearly do; poison centres treat household bleach under the usual 15 to 20 minutes. The advice points the safe way, because rinsing longer does no harm, so the sentence is not false. The recorded video says this same sentence word for word, and the video cannot be remade. Keeping it means the text and video differ only where the operator removed 'ten minste' (N10, 18 November 2026). Accepted 25 November 2026 after HTML-team query N10.
